Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I've been reading about Kazi Law Chamber — the 30-year track record and the international client roster (UK, USA, Canada, EU, ASEAN) is genuinely impressive, and the Barrister Bodruddoza YouTube presence is strong.

But the intake is a single wa.me link plus a basic form. For an international clientele browsing at 11pm their time (your 3am), that means the lead is comparing your firm to two London/US firms in real time — and you don't reply until the next BD business day. For high-value cross-border matters (corporate, immigration, commercial), response speed is the conversion lever.

I built an AI intake agent that lives on your website and WhatsApp — it triages every matter type (corporate vs civil vs immigration), sends the right document checklist before the first meeting, and books a consultation that fits the client's timezone. Your lawyers walk into the first meeting with a structured brief — not a 2-line WhatsApp message.

I've built a working demo using your firm's actual matter types — happy to show you in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
